objective: Discover actual source interfaces and tests; freeze the smallest default-disabled shadow async-memory implementation task
summary: Existing RD27 immutable lifecycle state and exit/update split provide a direct source extension point. Authorize additive async-memory sidecar APIs and synthetic tests only; no historical formulas, economics, activation or replay.
north_star_effect: Restores testable causal exit-brain software progress while withholding economic and production claims.

interfaces: LifecyclePosition at 69: pair, entry_time, entry_price, atr24_at_signal, high_water_prior, protection_floor
ExitDecision at 79: should_exit, exit_price, exit_reason and diagnostics
source_inventory.reuse: Frozen dataclass/replace, LifecyclePosition lifecycle context and timestamp conventions. Do not reuse price thresholds as new observation formulas or alter existing exit rules.

interfaces: pending_updates decision phase then completed-bar update at 561-574
ShadowPosition at 48 includes position_id and lifecycle
replay_same_pair_secondary_shadow at 193 defaults disabled and delegates native path
pending orders execute only at timestamp strictly greater than execute_after

test_inventory.exclude: test_control_decision_matches_rd26_time_fail_synthetic_path invokes strategy replay and is not authorized in the next task

next_implementation_contract.smallest_change: Add immutable async-memory observation/state/shadow-result types and pure transition/reset functions alongside existing LifecyclePosition, using it as lifecycle context. No new trading-position abstraction and no change to existing evaluate_adaptive_exit/ExitDecision behavior.
next_implementation_contract.input_contract: Explicit position_id using existing shadow identity convention plus LifecyclePosition context; independently supplied boolean state_observed and trigger_observed; UTC completed-bar/observation time, available_at and decision_time. No OHLCV loading, feature computation or E/A/G/EAG/P aliases. Reject missing/unknown booleans rather than converting to false. These are plumbing inputs, not adopted economic predicates.
next_implementation_contract.age_semantics: Elapsed time from latest_seen_time to decision_time is a diagnostic only, absent before first observation; no timeout/expiry threshold or forced 1H/4H cadence.
transition_semantics: Default disabled: no accumulation and no actionable/shadow readiness; return inactive/reset diagnostic without changing LifecyclePosition or ExitDecision.
Enabled only by explicit shadow flag; return readiness diagnostics, never an order, exit price, production decision or portfolio mutation.
Evaluate readiness from previously remembered completed observations and a separately supplied later trigger; first state and trigger on the same observation cannot satisfy strict-later readiness.
Require remembered observation time strictly earlier than trigger observation time and all observation/availability times no later than decision_time. Do not read current-bar future values.
Then update memory from the current completed observation; preserve first seen, refresh latest seen, increment episodes only on false-to-true state transition.
Exact duplicate observation is idempotent; conflicting same-time or decreasing-time observation fails closed. No silent sorting.
New position instance/entry lifecycle starts empty. Explicit close/reset/disable clears memory with reset reason. Never transfer memory across positions or re-entry.
No TTL, economic thresholds, maximum-hold optimization, historical A formula, regime formula or trigger formula is introduced.
required_tests: disabled default no-op and readiness false
state then false interval then later trigger
first same-bar state plus trigger not ready
exact duplicate idempotence and conflicting duplicate failure
deterministic snapshot/restore observation sequence without strategy replay
next_implementation_contract.validation_scope: New synthetic observation-sequence tests plus selected pure existing unit regressions only. No full-suite run, strategy replay, data fixtures, filesystem market reads or PnL assertions.
